method: one bounded, read-only, pinned-host-key Gemian LAN SSH capture of matching boot-log lines

observations.dynamic_consys_reservation: 0xbfa00000..0xbfbfffff, 2 MiB, as reported by this boot
observations.gen3_wlan_init: do_wlan_drv_init logged WLAN-GEN3 driver init, ret:0
observations.netdev: wlan0 later logged link becomes ready
observations.nvram_daemon: init logged start and later exit with status 0

limits: The observation joins the logged request and selected init path for this one boot; it does not prove the same path on every boot.
The vendor aggregate and probe messages do not prove each component succeeded or establish firmware image identity, calibration application, safe radio policy, teardown or mainline support.
The filtered boot log is not a complete execution trace. A separate /proc/iomem read was denied and supplies no resource ownership evidence.
The raw boot-log capture and SSH transport remain private; no radio or device state was changed.
